content.title: Seasonal Store Hours & Openings
content.text: Free shipping with $49 purchase. details Fast & free store pickup! details Take an extra 30%, 20%, or 15% off when you use a Kohl's Card.​ details Kohl's Help HomeSeasonal Store Hours & OpeningsKohl's stores are closed on the following three holidays: Easter Sunday Thanksgiving Day Christmas Day Special & Extended Hours Kohl's is well-known for significantly expanding shopping hours during the peak winter shopping season! The eve of major holidays may have reduced hours: Black Friday Days leading up to Christmas Christmas Eve New Year's Eve New Year's Day Holidays with Regular Hours Kohl's will be open with standard or near-standard operating hours on the following holidays: New Year's Day Martin Luther King Jr. Day President's Day Memorial Day Juneteenth Independence Day (July 4th) Labor Day Columbus Day / Indigenous People's Day Veterans Day Opening hours may be impacted on holidays. For store hours at the location nearest you, use our Store Locator.Related AnswersFree Ship to StoreBuy Online, Pick Up in StoreContact Us Privacy ChoicesBrowser Opt-Out Request HonoredKohl's CookiesRequired CookiesOpt-out of the Sale or Sharing of Personal Information (including Targeted Advertising)Kohl's CookiesWhen you visit any website, it may store or retrieve information on your browser, mostly in the form of cookies. This information might be about you, your preferences or your device and is mostly used to make the site work as you expect it to. The information does not usually directly identify you, but it can give you a more personalized web experience. Under law, California and Virginia residents have the right to tell us not to “sell” their personal information. At Kohl’s, the only “sales” we make (as defined by Applicable law) are to share certain information among our affiliates consisting of cookies stored on your browser to provide more relevant ads to you on our sites, apps, and on other sites that you visit. On this page you can choose not to allow some types of cookies. Click on the different category headings to find out more and change the default settings. However, blocking some types of cookies may impact your experience of the site and the services we are able to offer.Required CookiesAlways ActiveThese cookies are necessary for the website to function and cannot be switched off in our systems. They are usually only set in response to actions made by you which amount to a request for services, such as setting your privacy preferences, logging in or filling in forms. You can set your browser to block or alert you about these cookies, but some parts of the site will not work. These cookies do not store any personally identifiable information.Opt-out of the Sale or Sharing of Personal Information (including Targeted Advertising) Opt-out of the Sale or Sharing of Personal Information (including Targeted Advertising) Active Under applicable state privacy laws, you have the right to opt-out of the “sale” or “sharing” of your personal information for cross-context behavioral or targeted advertising. While opting out may limit the personalized offers and services we can provide, we respect your choice to manage your data. To opt-out, toggle the setting above to “Inactive” and click “Confirm My Choices,” or click “Reject All.” To Opt-Out of Offline Data Sharing: If you have previously provided Kohl’s with your email or other personal information, we may have shared it with third parties for marketing purposes. To stop the sale or sharing of this information, please complete this webform here. At Kohl’s, these activities include: Digital Sharing: Using cookies and tracking pixels to share browsing activity with affiliates and third parties (such as social media platforms) to show you relevant ads. Note: If the toggle is already "Inactive," your browser may have already sent a Global Privacy Control (GPC) signal, or you may have previously updated your settings. Offline Sharing: Sharing or selling identifiers and purchase history with third-party partners and data brokers to better understand our customers and improve our marketing. If you would like to exercise additional privacy rights, please visit the Kohl’s Privacy Center.
